$comment: Size budgets enforced per PR by pnpm size:check over the production build (mw-e32.3). Sizes are decimal (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes), like perf-budgets.json. Initial JS is gzipped at level 9. The 50 MB ceiling is the initial download cap of docs/backlog-contract.md §1 Hardware baseline. A waiver names one file, its own byte ceiling, why, and the bead that removes it; never raise a cap to make a build pass. toolWaivers are the src/tools modules known to leak into the release bundle; each prefix must go (the check warns when one matches nothing).

waivers.reason: The approved 3:00 Suno take of music-open-world encodes to 3.65 MB as AAC (2.86 MB as Ogg); it needs re-encoding at a lower bitrate, which mw-e32.19 does.

toolWaivers.reason: src/main.ts imports it statically and the release build still bundles it into the main chunk; it has to move behind a dynamic import gated on the scene or debug flag.
